title: narrative tenses and aspect review
rule_uz: Hikoya aytganda asosiy voqealar Past Simple bilan beriladi. Past Continuous voqea fonini yoki boshqa ish paytida davom etayotgan ishni ko'rsatadi. Past Perfect hikoyadagi voqeadan oldin bo'lgan ishni bildiradi. Past Perfect Continuous esa o'sha paytgacha davom etgan jarayonni va uning natijasini tushuntiradi.

examples.en: While we were hiking, it started to rain, so we put on the jackets we had packed.
examples.uz: Biz sayr qilayotganimizda yomg'ir yog'a boshladi, shuning uchun solib olgan kurtkalarimizni kiydik.

examples.en: She was exhausted because she had been revising since dawn.
examples.uz: U juda charchagan edi, chunki tong otganidan beri takrorlayotgan edi.

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
examples.uz: Bekatga yetib borganimda poyezd allaqachon ketib qolgan edi.

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the film already started.
mistakes.right: When I arrived, the film had already started.
mistakes.note_uz: Kelishdan oldin boshlangan ish uchun Past Perfect kerak.

mistakes.wrong: I was having a shower when the phone was ringing.
mistakes.right: I was having a shower when the phone rang.
mistakes.note_uz: Uzilib qolgan qisqa voqea Past Simple bilan beriladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ a book when the lights went out.

title: present perfect and continuous: nuances
rule_uz: Present Perfect Simple tugagan ishning natijasiga yoki necha marta bo'lganiga e'tibor beradi. Present Perfect Continuous esa jarayonning o'ziga, uning davomiyligiga va yaqinda to'xtagan ishga e'tibor beradi. Davomiylikni so'raganda how long, soni haqida so'raganda how many ishlatiladi. Ba'zi fe'llar (know, like, belong) odatda continuous shaklda kelmaydi.

examples.en: I've been painting the fence all morning, and I've finished two sides.
examples.uz: Ertalabdan beri to'siqni bo'yayapman va ikki tomonini tugatdim.

examples.en: Your hands are covered in flour. Have you been baking?
examples.uz: Qo'llaringiz un bo'lib ketibdi. Non yopayotgan edingizmi?

examples.en: She has known her best friend since primary school.
examples.uz: U eng yaqin do'sti bilan boshlang'ich maktabdan beri tanish.

mistakes.wrong: I have been knowing him for years.
mistakes.right: I have known him for years.
mistakes.note_uz: Know holat fe'li, continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: I have been writing five emails today.
mistakes.right: I have written five emails today.
mistakes.note_uz: Son aytilsa, Present Perfect Simple ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: How long ___ English?
I ___ this phone for three years.
Tom ___ three goals this season.
Why are your shoes so muddy? ___ in the garden?
She ___ the same song for an hour, and I'm getting tired of it.

title: past perfect: in reporting and storytelling
title_uz: Past Perfect: hikoya va xabar berishda
rule_uz: Past Perfect (had + past participle) o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin sodir bo'lgan ishni bildiradi. Hikoyada voqealar tartibini aniq qilish uchun ishlatiladi, masalan sabab yoki oldingi holatni tushuntirishda. Reported speech'da Present Perfect va Past Simple ko'pincha Past Perfect'ga aylanadi. Ishlar ketma-ket va tartibi aniq bo'lsa, Past Perfect shart emas.
forms: after / by the time / as soon as + had + p.p.

examples.en: He explained that he had missed the bus, which was why he was late.
examples.uz: U avtobusga kechikkanini, shu sabab kech qolganini tushuntirdi.

examples.en: The village looked empty because everyone had gone to the festival.
examples.uz: Qishloq huvillab turardi, chunki hamma bayramga ketgan edi.

examples.en: She told me she had never seen the sea before that trip.
examples.uz: U menga bu safargacha dengizni hech ko'rmaganini aytdi.

mistakes.wrong: She said she has finished her homework earlier.
mistakes.right: She said she had finished her homework earlier.
mistakes.note_uz: Reported speech'da has finished -> had finished.

mistakes.wrong: After he had arrived, he had called me, then he had had dinner.
mistakes.right: After he had arrived, he called me, then he had dinner.
mistakes.note_uz: Faqat birinchi (oldingi) ish Past Perfect, keyingilari Past Simple.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Anna said she ___ the book already.
After we ___ the museum, we went for lunch.
He was upset because he ___ his wallet on the train.
By the time I phoned, they ___ dinner, so we talked later.
I realised I ___ the oven off, so I rushed home.
The teacher asked why nobody ___ the task.

title: future forms: be about to, be to, be due to
title_uz: Kelasi zamon: be about to, be to, be due to
rule_uz: Be about to + fe'l hozir, bir zumda boshlanadigan ishni bildiradi. Be to + fe'l rasmiy rejalar, buyruqlar yoki kelishuvlarni ifodalaydi (yangiliklarda ko'p uchraydi). Be due to + fe'l jadval bo'yicha kutilayotgan ishni bildiradi: poyezd, uchrashuv, tug'ilish va hokazo. Uchalasida ham be fe'li zamon va shaxsga qarab o'zgaradi.
forms: be about to + infinitive (juda yaqin kelajak)
was about to + infinitive (shu paytda ... edi)

examples.en: Hurry up! The film is about to start.
examples.uz: Tezroq! Film hozir boshlanadi.

examples.en: The president is to visit our city next month.
examples.uz: Prezident kelasi oy shahrimizga tashrif buyuradi.

examples.en: The flight from London is due to land at nine.
examples.uz: Londondan kelayotgan reys soat to'qqizda qo'nishi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: I'm about to going out.
mistakes.right: I'm about to go out.
mistakes.note_uz: Be about to dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: The train is about to arrive at 6.15 tomorrow.
mistakes.right: The train is due to arrive at 6.15 tomorrow.
mistakes.note_uz: Aniq vaqt bilan jadval uchun due to ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Be quiet! The teacher is about ___ speak.
The bus is ___ to leave at 8.30, but it's late.
I was about to call you ___ you rang me.
The new library is ___ open next spring, according to the mayor.
Wait a moment! I ___ to tell you something important.

title: future perfect and future continuous in use
rule_uz: Future Continuous (will be + -ing) kelajakda ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi. U shuningdek, kelajakda o'z-o'zidan bo'ladigan rejalashtirilgan ishlarni ham aytadi. Future Perfect (will have + past participle) kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtgacha tugagan bo'ladigan ishni bildiradi. Bunda by, by the time kabi so'zlar ko'p ishlatiladi.
forms: by + vaqt / by the time + Present Simple

examples.en: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Istanbul.
examples.uz: Ertaga shu paytda men Istanbulga uchib ketayotgan bo'laman.

examples.en: By next June, she will have finished her degree.
examples.uz: Kelasi iyunga kelib u o'qishini tugatgan bo'ladi.

examples.en: By the time you arrive, we'll have set the table.
examples.uz: Siz yetib kelguningizcha biz dasturxonni tayyorlab qo'yamiz.

mistakes.wrong: By the time you will arrive, I will have left.
mistakes.right: By the time you arrive, I will have left.
mistakes.note_uz: By the time dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi, Present Simple keladi.

mistakes.wrong: At 8 tonight I will have watched TV.
mistakes.right: At 8 tonight I will be watching TV.
mistakes.note_uz: Aniq paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun Future Continuous.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Don't call at noon. I ___ in a meeting.
By Friday, I ___ all my exams.
This time next week we ___ on a beach in Spain.
By the time the guests ___, the cake will be ready.
In 2030, scientists ___ a cure for the disease, I hope.
By July, they ___ in this house for ten years.

title: unreal past: wish / if only (advanced)
title_uz: Wish / if only: afsus va istaklar
rule_uz: Wish va if only hozirgi yoki o'tmishdagi afsuslanishni bildiradi. Hozirgi holatga afsuslansak, wish dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi: I wish I had more time. O'tmishdagi ishga afsuslansak, Past Perfect ishlatiladi: I wish I had studied. Kelajakda o'zgarishni xohlamasak yoki ko'nikmagan narsadan noroziligimizni aytsak, wish + would ishlatiladi. Wish dan keyin I/he bilan ham were ishlatish mumkin.
forms: wish / if only + Past Simple (hozirgi holat)
wish / if only + Past Perfect (o'tmishdagi afsus)

examples.en: I wish I lived closer to the sea.
examples.uz: Qani endi dengizga yaqinroq yashasam.

examples.en: If only we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the concert.
examples.uz: Qani endi erta chiqqanimizda edi, konsertga kechikmagan bo'lardik.

examples.en: I wish my brother would stop borrowing my headphones.
examples.uz: Akam quloqchinlarimni so'ramay olishni bas qilsa edi.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I would have more free time.
mistakes.right: I wish I had more free time.
mistakes.note_uz: O'zimizning holatimiz uchun wish + would emas, Past Simple.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I studied harder last year.
mistakes.right: I wish I had studied harder last year.
mistakes.note_uz: O'tgan yilga afsus uchun Past Perfect kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I wish I ___ a bigger room. Mine is tiny.
She wishes she ___ how to swim.
If only I ___ the answer yesterday, I would have passed.
I wish it ___ raining. We want to play outside.
He wishes he ___ so rudely to his teacher last week.

title: conditionals review (all types)
rule_uz: Zero conditional umumiy haqiqatlar uchun: if + Present Simple, Present Simple. First conditional real kelajak uchun: if + Present Simple, will + fe'l. Second conditional xayoliy hozirgi yoki kelajak uchun: if + Past Simple, would + fe'l. Third conditional o'tmishda bo'lmagan narsa uchun: if + Past Perfect, would have + past participle. If gapi oldin kelsa, orasiga vergul qo'yiladi.
forms: Zero: if + Present Simple, Present Simple
First: if + Present Simple, will + infinitive
Second: if + Past Simple, would + infinitive
Third: if + Past Perfect, would have + p.p.

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.uz: Muzni qizdirsangiz, u erib ketadi.

examples.en: If I won a free ticket, I would travel to Japan.
examples.uz: Agar bepul chipta yutsam, Yaponiyaga sayohat qilgan bo'lardim.

examples.en: If she had revised more, she would have passed the test.
examples.uz: Agar u ko'proq takrorlaganida, testdan o'tgan bo'lardi.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.note_uz: If dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have time, I would help you.
mistakes.right: If I had time, I would help you.
mistakes.note_uz: If qismida would emas, Past Simple ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
If I ___ a car, I would drive to school.
If we ___ the map, we wouldn't have got lost.
What would you do if you ___ a stranger's wallet in the street?

title: inverted conditionals (Had I known, Should you, Were I)
rule_uz: Rasmiyroq uslubda if o'rniga inversiya (yordamchi fe'lni egadan oldin qo'yish) ishlatiladi. Third conditional: Had I known, I would have helped. Second conditional: Were I you, I would apologise. First conditional rasmiy: Should you need help, call me. Inversiyada if tushib qoladi, inkor esa Had I not known, Were it not for ... tarzida beriladi (not egadan keyin).
forms: Had + ega + past participle, ... would have + p.p.

examples.en: Had I known about the exam, I would have studied harder.
examples.uz: Imtihon haqida bilganimda, ko'proq tayyorlanardim.

examples.en: Were I in your position, I would accept the offer.
examples.uz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, taklifni qabul qilardim.

examples.en: Should you have any questions, please contact our office.
examples.uz: Savollaringiz bo'lsa, iltimos, ofisimizga murojaat qiling.

mistakes.wrong: Had I would known, I would have called you.
mistakes.right: Had I known, I would have called you.
mistakes.note_uz: Inversiyada Had dan keyin would qo'yilmaydi, faqat past participle keladi.

mistakes.wrong: Should you will need help, ask me.
mistakes.right: Should you need help, ask me.
mistakes.note_uz: Should dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: ___ I known the road was closed, I would have taken another route.
___ you need a ride, just text me.
___ I you, I would talk to the teacher.
Had she ___ the instructions, she would have finished faster.
Had they not ___ so late, they wouldn't have missed the ferry.
Were it not ___ your help, I would still be stuck on this problem.

title: conditional alternatives (supposing, provided, otherwise, but for)
rule_uz: Provided (that), providing (that), as long as va on condition that faqat shart bajarilsa degan ma'noni beradi, ularning ketidan Present Simple keladi. Supposing o'ylab ko'rish uchun: Supposing you lost your phone, what would you do? Otherwise esa agar shunday bo'lmasa, nima bo'lishini aytadi. But for + ot yordam yoki sabab bo'lmaganda nima bo'lishini bildiradi. Unless = if ... not.

examples.en: You can borrow my laptop, provided that you return it on Monday.
examples.uz: Noutbukimni olishingiz mumkin, faqat dushanba kuni qaytarsangiz.

examples.en: Supposing you could live anywhere, where would you choose?
examples.uz: Tasavvur qiling, istagan joyda yashay olsangiz, qayerni tanlardingiz?

examples.en: But for the coach's advice, we would have lost the match.
examples.uz: Murabbiyning maslahati bo'lmaganida, o'yinda yutqazgan bo'lardik.

mistakes.wrong: I'll go providing it will not rain.
mistakes.right: I'll go providing it doesn't rain.
mistakes.note_uz: Providing dan keyin ham will ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: But for you helped me, I would have failed.
mistakes.right: But for your help, I would have failed.
mistakes.note_uz: But for dan keyin gap emas, ot (birikma) keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You can stay out late ___ you phone us.
Take a map, ___ you'll get lost.
I'll lend you the money ___ that you pay it back soon.
___ you won a million, what would you buy first?

We'll play outside ___ it rains.

title: mixed conditionals (advanced)
rule_uz: Aralash shart gapda if qismi va natija qismi turli vaqtga tegishli bo'ladi. O'tmishdagi sabab hozirgi natijaga ta'sir qilsa: if + Past Perfect, would + fe'l (If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now). Hozirgi doimiy holat o'tmishdagi natijani o'zgartirsa: if + Past Simple, would have + past participle. Zamon belgilari (now, yesterday, then) qaysi turni tanlashga yordam beradi.
forms: If + Past Perfect, would + infinitive (o'tmish -> hozir)
If + Past Simple, would have + p.p. (hozir -> o'tmish)
If I had ..., I would be ... now
If I weren't ..., I would have ...

examples.en: If I had taken the job in Dubai, I would be living there now.
examples.uz: Dubaydagi ishni olganimda, hozir o'sha yerda yashagan bo'lardim.

examples.en: If she were more careful, she wouldn't have broken the screen yesterday.
examples.uz: U ehtiyotkorroq bo'lganida, kecha ekranni sindirmagan bo'lardi.

examples.en: We would be at the beach now if the weather hadn't turned bad.
examples.uz: Ob-havo buzilmaganida, hozir sohilda bo'lardik.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have saved money, I would have a new bike now.
mistakes.right: If I had saved money, I would have a new bike now.
mistakes.note_uz: If qismida would have emas, Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: If I would be taller, I would have joined the team.
mistakes.right: If I were taller, I would have joined the team.
mistakes.note_uz: If qismida would ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: If I had gone to bed earlier, I ___ so tired now.
If he ___ more confident, he would have spoken at the meeting yesterday.
If we had booked tickets, we ___ on the plane right now.
She ___ fluent French now if she had stayed in Paris.

title: It's time + past; would rather + past
title_uz: It's time va would rather + o'tgan zamon
rule_uz: It's time (high time, about time) + Past Simple hozir bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan, lekin hali bajarilmagan ishni bildiradi, ko'pincha biroz norozilik bilan. Would rather + Past Simple boshqa odam hozir yoki kelajakda nima qilishini xohlaganimizni bildiradi. Would rather + Past Perfect o'tmishdagi afsusni ifodalaydi. O'zimiz haqimizda gapirsak, would rather + fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.
forms: I'd rather + ega + Past Simple (hozir / kelajak)

examples.en: It's time you started preparing for the exam.
examples.uz: Imtihonga tayyorlana boshlashingiz vaqti keldi.

examples.en: I'd rather you didn't use my laptop without asking.
examples.uz: So'ramasdan noutbukimdan foydalanmasangiz yaxshi bo'lardi.

examples.en: I'd rather we had taken the earlier train.
examples.uz: Oldingi poyezdga o'tirganimizda yaxshi bo'lardi.

mistakes.wrong: It's time you go to bed.
mistakes.right: It's time you went to bed.
mistakes.note_uz: It's time + ega dan keyin Past Simple keladi.

mistakes.wrong: I'd rather you to stay at home.
mistakes.right: I'd rather you stayed at home.
mistakes.note_uz: Would rather dan keyin to emas, Past Simple ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It's time we ___ home.
I'd rather you ___ so loudly in the library.
I'd rather ___ pizza than pasta tonight.
It's high time the government ___ more for public transport.
She'd rather her son ___ video games all weekend.
I'd rather I ___ the invitation. The party was boring.

title: as if / as though
rule_uz: As if va as though bir narsa qanday ko'rinishini yoki sezilishini, ko'pincha haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan taqqos bilan, bildiradi. Agar gapirilayotgan narsa haqiqatda shunday bo'lsa, Present yoki Past Simple ishlatiladi: He looks as if he is ill. Agar gap xayoliy yoki aniq haqiqat emas bo'lsa, Past Simple (were) yoki Past Perfect ishlatiladi. Look, sound, feel, seem fe'llaridan keyin keladi. Rasmiy bo'lmagan nutqda like ham ishlatiladi.
forms: look / sound / feel + as if + Present Simple (haqiqat bo'lishi mumkin)

examples.en: It looks as if it's going to snow tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun qor yog'adiganga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: He talks as though he were the manager, but he's only an intern.
examples.uz: U o'zini menejerdek tutadi, lekin u shunchaki stajyor.

examples.en: She looked as if she had seen a ghost.
examples.uz: U go'yo arvoh ko'rgandek ko'rinardi.

mistakes.wrong: He behaves as if he is the king of the school.
mistakes.right: He behaves as if he were the king of the school.
mistakes.note_uz: Haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan holatda were ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She looked as if she is very tired.
mistakes.right: She looked as if she was very tired.
mistakes.note_uz: Asosiy gap o'tmishda bo'lsa, zamon ham moslashadi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You look as ___ you haven't slept all night.
The sky is dark. It looks as if it ___ rain soon.
He spends money as though he ___ a millionaire.
She spoke as if she ___ the answer, but she was only guessing.
The boy looked as though he ___ a long way.

title: reporting passives (He is said to ...)
rule_uz: Reporting passive biror narsa haqida odamlar nima deyishini yoki o'ylashini, kimligini aytmasdan, bildiradi: He is said to be rich. Ega + passive (is said, is believed, is thought, is reported) + to + infinitive shaklida tuziladi. Agar ish ayni paytda emas, balki oldinroq bo'lgan bo'lsa, perfect infinitive (to have + p.p.) ishlatiladi. Davom etayotgan ish uchun to be + -ing keladi. Yana It is said that ... tuzilishi ham bor.
forms: ega + is / are said / believed / thought + to + infinitive
ega + is said + to have + past participle
It is said / believed that + gap

examples.en: The castle is believed to be over eight hundred years old.
examples.uz: Qasr sakkiz yuz yildan ham qadimiyroq deb hisoblanadi.

examples.en: The thieves are thought to have escaped by car.
examples.uz: O'g'rilar mashinada qochib ketgan deb taxmin qilinmoqda.

examples.en: The singer is reported to be recording a new album.
examples.uz: Xabarlarga ko'ra, xonanda yangi albom yozmoqda.

mistakes.wrong: He is said that he is very clever.
mistakes.right: He is said to be very clever. / It is said that he is very clever.
mistakes.note_uz: Ikkita tuzilishni aralashtirib bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: The bridge is believed to built in 1900.
mistakes.right: The bridge is believed to have been built in 1900.
mistakes.note_uz: O'tmishdagi ish uchun perfect infinitive kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The museum is said ___ the oldest in the country.
It ___ that the team will win the title.
The two boys are thought ___ the window last night.
The famous actor is reported ___ in Canada at the moment.
This tree is said ___ planted by my great-grandfather.
Honey is known ___ bacteria.

title: passive with two objects; get passive
title_uz: Ikki to'ldiruvchili majhul nisbat; get passive
rule_uz: Give, send, show, offer kabi fe'llarning ikkita to'ldiruvchisi bor, shuning uchun passive gapni ikki xil tuzish mumkin. Odatda odamni ega qilamiz: She was given a prize. Narsani ega qilsak, to bilan: A prize was given to her. Get + past participle kutilmagan yoki yoqimsiz hodisalar haqida so'zlashuv nutqida ishlatiladi: He got hurt. Get passive'da ish kim qilgani odatda aytilmaydi.
forms: get + ega + p.p. (get married, get lost)

examples.en: The winners were handed medals by the mayor.
examples.uz: G'oliblarga medallarni mer topshirdi.

examples.en: A free ticket was offered to every student.
examples.uz: Har bir talabaga bepul chipta taklif qilindi.

examples.en: My bike got stolen outside the school yesterday.
examples.uz: Velosipedim kecha maktab oldida o'g'irlab ketildi.

mistakes.wrong: A new phone was given my sister.
mistakes.right: A new phone was given to my sister.
mistakes.note_uz: Narsa ega bo'lsa, odamdan oldin to qo'yiladi.

mistakes.wrong: The window got to break by the ball.
mistakes.right: The window got broken by the ball.
mistakes.note_uz: Get dan keyin past participle (broken) keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The children ___ some sweets by their aunt.
I ___ an email from the headteacher yesterday.
The report was shown ___ the whole team.
Careful! You'll ___ hurt if you climb that wall.
My cousin ___ married last June.
Several students ___ jobs in the new factory.

title: causative (have / get / make / let)
rule_uz: Have something done bizning o'rnimizga boshqa odam ish qilganini bildiradi: I had my hair cut. Get something done ham shu ma'noda, lekin so'zlashuvroq. Have somebody do (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri) va get somebody to do (ko'ndirib) odamga topshirilgan ishni bildiradi. Make somebody do majburlashni, let somebody do ruxsat berishni bildiradi; ularda to ishlatilmaydi.
forms: make / let + odam + fe'lning asosiy shakli

examples.en: We had the roof repaired after the storm.
examples.uz: Bo'rondan keyin tomni ta'mirlatdik.

examples.en: She got her brother to carry the heavy bags.
examples.uz: U akasini og'ir sumkalarni ko'tarishga ko'ndirdi.

examples.en: Our teacher made us rewrite the whole essay.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizni butun inshoni qaytadan yozishga majbur qildi.

mistakes.wrong: I must have repair my bike.
mistakes.right: I must have my bike repaired.
mistakes.note_uz: Narsadan keyin past participle ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: My parents don't let me to stay out late.
mistakes.right: My parents don't let me stay out late.
mistakes.note_uz: Let dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

title: reported speech: exceptions to backshift
rule_uz: Odatda reported speech'da zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi. Lekin gap hozir ham to'g'ri bo'lsa, umumiy haqiqat bo'lsa yoki xabar beruvchi fe'l Present bo'lsa, zamon o'zgarmasligi mumkin. Should, would, could, might, ought to, used to va Past Perfect o'zgarmaydi. Agar gapirilgan narsa hali ham to'g'ri bo'lsa, ikkala variant ham to'g'ri.
forms: Hozir ham to'g'ri: He said the shop closes at nine.
Umumiy haqiqat: She said water boils at 100 degrees.

examples.en: The teacher said that the Earth goes round the Sun.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi Yer Quyosh atrofida aylanishini aytdi.

examples.en: Anna told me she could swim when she was four.
examples.uz: Anna menga to'rt yoshida suzishni bilganini aytdi.

mistakes.right: She said that the sun rises in the east.
mistakes.note_uz: Umumiy haqiqatda zamon odatda o'zgarmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: He said I had to should study more.
mistakes.right: He said I should study more.
mistakes.note_uz: Should o'zgarmaydi, ikkita modal ishlatilmaydi.

title: reporting verb patterns
rule_uz: Reporting fe'llarning har biri o'ziga xos tuzilish talab qiladi. Suggest, admit, deny, recommend + -ing yoki that gap. Agree, promise, refuse, offer + to + infinitive. Advise, warn, remind, invite, persuade + odam + to + infinitive. Accuse somebody of, apologise for, insist on kabi fe'llar predlog va -ing talab qiladi. Say dan keyin odam kelmaydi, tell dan keyin odam keladi.
forms: agree / promise / refuse / offer + to + infinitive
advise / warn / remind + odam + to + infinitive

examples.en: She admitted breaking the window.
examples.uz: U derazani sindirganini tan oldi.

examples.en: Our coach warned us not to swim in the river.
examples.uz: Murabbiyimiz bizni daryoda suzmaslikka ogohlantirdi.

examples.en: He apologised for being late.
examples.uz: U kechikkani uchun uzr so'radi.

mistakes.wrong: She suggested to go to the park.
mistakes.right: She suggested going to the park.
mistakes.note_uz: Suggest dan keyin to + infinitive emas, -ing keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He said me to wait outside.
mistakes.right: He told me to wait outside.
mistakes.note_uz: Say dan keyin odam kelmaydi; tell + odam ishlatiladi.

title: speculation about the past (modals perfect)
rule_uz: O'tmishdagi voqea haqida taxmin qilganda modal fe'l + have + past participle ishlatamiz. Must have juda ishonchli xulosa, can't / couldn't have mumkin emasligini ko'rsatadi. May / might / could have ehtimol, ishonchsiz taxminni bildiradi. Inkor ehtimol uchun might not have ishlatiladi; may not have ham shu ma'noda. Hozirda davom etayotgan jarayon uchun must be -ing ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The lights are off, so they must have gone to bed.
examples.uz: Chiroqlar o'chiq, demak ular uxlagan bo'lsa kerak.

examples.en: She can't have forgotten my birthday. She wrote it in her diary.
examples.uz: U tug'ilgan kunimni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas. U buni kundaligiga yozgan.

examples.en: He might have taken the wrong bus, because he's very late.
examples.uz: U noto'g'ri avtobusga o'tirgan bo'lishi mumkin, chunki u juda kech qoldi.

mistakes.wrong: The test was easy. He must failed it.
mistakes.right: He can't have failed it.
mistakes.note_uz: Mantiqan imkonsiz bo'lsa, can't have + p.p. ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: They might went home early.
mistakes.right: They might have gone home early.
mistakes.note_uz: Might dan keyin have + past participle kerak.

title: criticism and regret (should have, ought to have, could have)
title_uz: Tanqid va afsus: should have, could have
rule_uz: Should have + past participle va ought to have + past participle o'tmishda qilinishi kerak edi, lekin qilinmagan ishni bildiradi (tanqid yoki afsus). Shouldn't have + p.p. qilinmasligi kerak bo'lgan, ammo qilingan ishni ko'rsatadi. Could have + p.p. o'tmishda mumkin bo'lgan, lekin amalga oshmagan imkoniyatni bildiradi. Needn't have + p.p. keraksiz qilingan ishni ko'rsatadi.
forms: should have / ought to have + p.p.

examples.en: You should have told me about the problem earlier.
examples.uz: Muammo haqida menga ertaroq aytishingiz kerak edi.

examples.en: We could have won if we had trained harder.
examples.uz: Ko'proq mashq qilganimizda yutishimiz mumkin edi.

examples.en: You needn't have brought food; we have plenty.
examples.uz: Ovqat olib kelishingizning keragi yo'q edi, bizda yetarli.

mistakes.wrong: You should told her the truth.
mistakes.right: You should have told her the truth.
mistakes.note_uz: Should dan keyin have + past participle kerak.

mistakes.wrong: I ought to went to bed earlier.
mistakes.right: I ought to have gone to bed earlier.
mistakes.note_uz: Ought to have + past participle ishlatiladi.

title: subtle meanings of may / might / could
rule_uz: May, might va could kelajak haqida ehtimolni bildiradi; might va could ko'proq ishonchsizlikni ko'rsatadi. May well va might well ehtimol katta ekanini bildiradi. Might as well va may as well boshqa yaxshi variant yo'q ekanini ko'rsatadi. Could taklif va imkoniyat uchun ishlatiladi. Could ehtimol ma'nosida ba'zan inkorda ishlatilmaydi: could not o'rniga may not / might not aytiladi.
forms: might as well + infinitive (boshqa choramiz yo'q)

examples.en: It might snow later, but I'm not certain.
examples.uz: Keyinroq qor yog'ishi mumkin, lekin aniq emasman.

examples.en: The tickets may well sell out by tomorrow.
examples.uz: Chiptalar ertagacha sotilib bo'lishi ehtimoldan xoli emas.

examples.en: There's nothing on TV, so we might as well go to bed.
examples.uz: Televizorda hech narsa yo'q, uxlashga yotsak ham bo'ladi.

mistakes.wrong: He couldn't be at home. I'm not sure.
mistakes.right: He might not be at home. I'm not sure.
mistakes.note_uz: Ishonchsiz inkor ehtimol uchun might not ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: We might as well to go home now.
mistakes.right: We might as well go home now.
mistakes.note_uz: Might as well dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

title: semi-modals: dare, need, be supposed to
title_uz: Yarim modal fe'llar: dare, need, be supposed to
rule_uz: Need va dare modal fe'l sifatida asosan inkor va savol gaplarda ishlatiladi: He needn't come. How dare you! Oddiy fe'l sifatida ular to bilan keladi va do/does yordamchi fe'lini oladi: She doesn't need to come. Be supposed to + infinitive kutilgan yoki kelishilgan ish haqida, ko'pincha qoida yoki rejaga ko'ra, gapiradi: You are supposed to arrive at 8. Was supposed to + infinitive bajarilmagan rejani bildiradi.
forms: needn't + infinitive / don't need to + infinitive

examples.en: You needn't wait for me; I can find my own way.
examples.uz: Meni kutishingiz shart emas, yo'limni o'zim topaman.

examples.en: I daren't tell my parents about the broken vase.
examples.uz: Singan vaza haqida ota-onamga aytishga jur'at etolmayman.

examples.en: We were supposed to meet at six, but he never came.
examples.uz: Biz oltida uchrashishimiz kerak edi, lekin u kelmadi.

mistakes.wrong: She doesn't need come to the meeting.
mistakes.right: She doesn't need to come to the meeting.
mistakes.note_uz: Oddiy fe'l sifatida need dan keyin to kerak.

mistakes.wrong: You are suppose to wear a uniform.
mistakes.right: You are supposed to wear a uniform.
mistakes.note_uz: Supposed to da -d harfi tushib qolmasin.

title: the subjunctive (I suggest that he go; It is essential that ...)
rule_uz: Subjunctive rasmiy uslubda taklif, talab va muhimlikni bildirgan gaplardan keyin ishlatiladi. Suggest, recommend, insist, demand, propose, request kabi fe'llardan va essential, vital, important, necessary kabi sifatlardan keyin that gap keladi. Bu gapda fe'l hamma shaxs uchun oddiy asosiy shaklda bo'ladi (-s qo'shilmaydi). Inkorda not fe'ldan oldin turadi. Britaniya ingliz tilida should + fe'l ham ishlatiladi.
forms: suggest / insist / demand + that + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli
It is essential / vital / important + that + ega + asosiy shakl

examples.en: The teacher insisted that every student hand in the essay on Friday.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi har bir o'quvchi inshoni juma kuni topshirishini talab qildi.

examples.en: It is vital that she see a doctor immediately.
examples.uz: Uning zudlik bilan shifokorga ko'rinishi juda muhim.

examples.en: I recommend that he not travel alone.
examples.uz: Men uning yolg'iz sayohat qilmasligini tavsiya etaman.

mistakes.wrong: I suggest that he goes to bed early.
mistakes.right: I suggest that he go to bed early.
mistakes.note_uz: Subjunctive'da he bilan ham -s qo'shilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: It is important that she doesn't miss the bus.
mistakes.right: It is important that she not miss the bus.
mistakes.note_uz: Rasmiy subjunctive inkori: ega + not + asosiy shakl.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The doctor recommended that he ___ more rest.

title: gerunds and infinitives (advanced)
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing, ba'zilaridan keyin to + infinitive keladi, ayrimlari esa ikkalasini ham oladi, lekin ma'nosi o'zgaradi. Remember to lock the door (qilish kerakligini eslash), remember locking (qilganini eslash). Stop to rest (dam olish uchun to'xtash), stop resting (dam olishni bas qilish). Try to do (harakat qilish), try doing (sinab ko'rish). Predloglardan keyin faqat -ing keladi.
forms: decide / manage / hope / afford + to + infinitive
remember / forget / stop / try + -ing yoki to + infinitive (ma'no farqi)

examples.en: I'll never forget meeting the president at the school fair.
examples.uz: Maktab yarmarkasida prezident bilan uchrashganimni hech unutmayman.

examples.en: Don't forget to switch off the lights when you leave.
examples.uz: Ketayotganingizda chiroqlarni o'chirishni unutmang.

examples.en: We stopped to take photos of the mountains.
examples.uz: Tog'larni suratga olish uchun to'xtadik.

mistakes.wrong: She is good at to draw.
mistakes.right: She is good at drawing.
mistakes.note_uz: Predlogdan keyin to emas, -ing keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He avoided to answer the question.
mistakes.right: He avoided answering the question.
mistakes.note_uz: Avoid dan keyin gerund (-ing) ishlatiladi.

title: perfect infinitive and perfect gerund
rule_uz: To have + past participle (perfect infinitive) asosiy ishdan oldin bo'lgan ishni bildiradi: I'm happy to have met you. Perfect gerund (having + past participle) ham oldingi ishni ko'rsatadi: He denied having seen her. Ular ko'pincha seem, appear, pretend, claim, be said, deny, admit, regret kabi so'zlardan keyin ishlatiladi. Would like / would have liked to have + p.p. bajarilmagan istakni bildiradi.
forms: seem / appear / pretend + to have + p.p.

examples.en: She seems to have lost her interest in music.
examples.uz: Uning musiqaga qiziqishi so'nganga o'xshaydi.

examples.en: He admitted having taken the money.
examples.uz: U pulni olganini tan oldi.

examples.en: I would love to have seen the show.
examples.uz: Shouni ko'rgan bo'lishni juda istardim.

mistakes.wrong: He denied to have broken the lamp.
mistakes.right: He denied having broken the lamp.
mistakes.note_uz: Deny dan keyin to have emas, gerund shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: She pretended to has been sick.
mistakes.right: She pretended to have been sick.
mistakes.note_uz: To dan keyin has emas, have ishlatiladi.

title: perception verbs + -ing / bare infinitive
rule_uz: See, hear, watch, notice, feel kabi sezgi fe'llaridan keyin odam va fe'l keladi. Fe'lning asosiy shakli (to siz) butun voqeani boshidan oxirigacha ko'rganimizni bildiradi: I saw him cross the road. -ing shakli esa ish davom etayotganda, yoki bir qismini ko'rganimizni bildiradi: I saw him crossing the road. Passive'da to qaytadi: He was seen to cross the road.
forms: see / hear / watch + odam + asosiy shakl (butun voqea)
feel / notice + odam + asosiy shakl yoki -ing
passive: ega + was seen + to + infinitive

examples.en: I heard the neighbours arguing when I walked past.
examples.uz: O'tib ketayotganimda qo'shnilarning tortishayotganini eshitdim.

examples.en: We watched the plane land on the runway.
examples.uz: Samolyotning uchish yo'lagiga qo'nishini tomosha qildik.

mistakes.right: I saw him leave the building.
mistakes.note_uz: Faol gapda see dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: He was heard sing in the shower.
mistakes.right: He was heard to sing in the shower.
mistakes.note_uz: Passive'da to infinitiv qaytadi.

title: participle clauses (present)
rule_uz: Present participle (-ing) bilan boshlanadigan gap bir vaqtda bo'layotgan yoki sabab bo'lgan ikkita ishni qisqa ifodalaydi. Ikkala ishning egasi bir xil bo'lishi kerak: Walking home, I met my teacher. Oldin sodir bo'lgan ish uchun having + past participle ishlatiladi. Inkorda not -ing dan oldin turadi. After, before, while, on kabi so'zlardan keyin ham -ing keladi.

examples.en: Opening the box, she found a letter from her grandfather.
examples.uz: Qutini ochib, u bobosidan xat topdi.

examples.en: Having finished the test, the students left the room.
examples.uz: Testni tugatgach, o'quvchilar xonadan chiqib ketishdi.

mistakes.note_uz: Participle ega bilan asosiy gap egasi bir xil bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Knowing not the way, we asked a stranger.
mistakes.right: Not knowing the way, we asked a stranger.
mistakes.note_uz: Inkorda not -ing dan oldin keladi.

title: participle clauses (past and perfect)
rule_uz: Ikki ish bir kishi tomonidan bajarilganda, gapni qisqartirish uchun sifatdosh oborotidan foydalanamiz. Passiv ma'noda V3 ishlatiladi: Built in 1990, the bridge is old. Ish boshqasidan oldin tugagan bo'lsa, having + V3 qo'llanadi: Having finished the test, she left. Passiv perfektda having been + V3 keladi. Oborotning egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart.

examples.en: Having finished our homework, we went out to play football.
examples.uz: Uy vazifamizni tugatib, futbol o'ynagani chiqdik.

examples.en: Written in simple language, the book is easy for teenagers to follow.
examples.uz: Oddiy tilda yozilgani uchun, kitobni o'smirlar osongina tushunadi.

examples.en: Not having studied enough, Dilnoza was nervous before the exam.
examples.uz: Yetarlicha tayyorlanmagani uchun Dilnoza imtihondan oldin xavotirda edi.

mistakes.right: Having finished the report, he switched off the computer.
mistakes.note_uz: Oborot egasi va bosh gap egasi bir xil bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.right: Seen from the hill, the city looks wonderful.
mistakes.note_uz: Gapning egasi 'ko'rilayotgan' narsa bo'lishi kerak.

title: relative clauses (advanced): whose, preposition + whom, which
rule_uz: Whose egalikni bildiradi va odam, hayvon yoki narsa uchun ishlatiladi: the girl whose bag is red. Rasmiy uslubda predlog who/which dan oldin keladi va who o'rniga whom bo'ladi: the teacher to whom I spoke. Which butun bir gapga ham ishora qila oladi: He passed, which surprised us. Bunday gapda vergul qo'yiladi. Predlog + which dan keyin that ishlatilmaydi.
forms: some / all / many + of whom / which

examples.en: The boy whose phone rang during the lesson apologised.
examples.uz: Darsda telefoni jiringlagan bola uzr so'radi.

examples.en: The professor with whom we worked was very helpful.
examples.uz: Biz birga ishlagan professor juda yordamchi edi.

examples.en: She won the national contest, which made her parents proud.
examples.uz: U respublika tanlovida g'olib bo'ldi, bu esa ota-onasini faxrlantirdi.

mistakes.right: The man whose car was stolen called the police.
mistakes.note_uz: Egalik uchun whose ishlatiladi, which emas.

mistakes.wrong: The girl with who I travelled is my cousin.
mistakes.right: The girl with whom I travelled is my cousin.
mistakes.note_uz: Predlogdan keyin who emas, whom keladi.

title: reduced relative clauses
rule_uz: Nisbiy gapni qisqartirib, ixchamroq gapirish mumkin. Faol ma'noda who/which/that + fe'l o'rniga -ing shakli qo'yiladi: the boy sitting there. Passiv ma'noda who is/was + V3 o'rniga faqat V3 qoladi: the book written by him. Sifat yoki predlogli ibora ham shu tarzda ishlatiladi: the people in the room. Ammo who/which fe'lning egasi bo'lib, aniqlovchi ma'no kuchli bo'lsagina qisqartirish mumkin.

examples.en: The students waiting outside are from another school.
examples.uz: Tashqarida kutayotgan o'quvchilar boshqa maktabdan.

examples.uz: Sayohat paytida olingan suratlar noutbukimda.

mistakes.note_uz: Faol ma'noda -ing shakli ishlatiladi, o'tgan zamon emas.

mistakes.wrong: The room cleaning yesterday is on the left.
mistakes.right: The room cleaned yesterday is on the left.
mistakes.note_uz: Passiv ma'noda V3 ishlatiladi, -ing emas.

title: noun clauses (that, what, whether)
rule_uz: Noun clause gapda ot vazifasini bajaradi: ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'lib keladi. That fakt haqida (I know that he is right), what 'nima' ma'nosida (What she said surprised me), whether/if esa 'yoki yo'qmi' ma'nosida ishlatiladi. Noun clause ichida so'roq gap tartibi bo'lmaydi: egasi fe'ldan oldin keladi. Predlogdan keyin faqat whether keladi, if emas.
forms: I wonder whether / if + subject + verb
not: Tell me where is he -> where he is

examples.en: What surprised everyone was the quiet ending of the film.
examples.uz: Hammani hayron qoldirgani filmning sokin yakuni bo'ldi.

examples.en: I'm not sure whether the museum opens on Mondays.
examples.uz: Muzey dushanba kunlari ochiq yoki yo'qligiga ishonchim komil emas.

examples.en: It is obvious that the team has worked hard.
examples.uz: Jamoa qattiq mehnat qilgani aniq.

mistakes.right: Can you tell me where the library is?
mistakes.note_uz: Noun clause ichida so'roq tartibi ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: We talked about if we should go.
mistakes.right: We talked about whether we should go.
mistakes.note_uz: Predlogdan keyin whether ishlatiladi.

title: cleft sentences (It was ... that; What ... is)
title_uz: Ajratuvchi gaplar: It was ... that; What ... is
rule_uz: Cleft gap gapning bir qismini alohida ta'kidlash uchun kerak. It + be + ta'kidlanayotgan qism + that/who: It was Lola who won. What bilan boshlangan gapda esa 'nima' ta'kidlanadi: What I need is a rest. Kerakli ma'noni bir marta kuchaytirish uchun ishlatamiz, ko'p ishlatish yaxshi emas. Zamon be fe'lida ham ko'rinadi: What happened was that ...
forms: It + is / was + focus + that / who + clause
What + subject + verb + is / was + focus
All / The thing + subject + verb + is ...

examples.en: It was my brother who broke the window, not me.
examples.uz: Derazani men emas, akam sindirgan.

examples.en: What I really enjoy is walking in the mountains.
examples.uz: Menga haqiqatan yoqadigan narsa tog'larda sayr qilishdir.

examples.en: It was in Bukhara that we first tried plov with quince.
examples.uz: Biz birinchi marta behili palovni aynan Buxoroda tatib ko'rganmiz.

mistakes.wrong: It was Ali what called me.
mistakes.right: It was Ali who called me.
mistakes.note_uz: Kishi uchun who yoki that ishlatiladi, what emas.

mistakes.wrong: What I want is that a new bike.
mistakes.right: What I want is a new bike.
mistakes.note_uz: What gapidan keyin is bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It was the noise ___ woke me up.
___ I need most is a good night's sleep.

What annoys me ___ people who talk during films.

title: inversion: negative adverbials (not only, no sooner, hardly)
title_uz: Inversiya: not only, no sooner, hardly
rule_uz: Nafiy ma'noli ravish gapning boshiga chiqsa, fe'l bilan ega o'rin almashadi, ya'ni yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin keladi. Bunday inversiya asosan rasmiy yoki kuchli ta'kidlovchi uslubda ishlatiladi. Not only ... but also, no sooner ... than, hardly ... when, never, rarely, seldom, little, under no circumstances kabi iboralarda uchraydi. Hardly/no sooner dan keyin odatda past perfect (had + V3) keladi.
forms: Never / Rarely / Seldom + auxiliary + subject + verb
Not only + auxiliary + subject + verb ..., but also ...
No sooner had + subject + V3 + than ...

examples.en: Never have I seen such a crowded beach.
examples.uz: Men hech qachon bunday gavjum plyajni ko'rmaganman.

examples.en: No sooner had we sat down than the film started.
examples.uz: Biz o'tirishimiz bilan film boshlandi.

examples.en: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
examples.uz: U nafaqat g'olib bo'ldi, balki rekordni ham yangiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Rarely we eat out on weekdays.
mistakes.right: Rarely do we eat out on weekdays.
mistakes.note_uz: Gap boshidagi nafiy ravishdan keyin yordamchi fe'l keladi.

mistakes.wrong: No sooner he had left when it started raining.
mistakes.right: No sooner had he left than it started raining.
mistakes.note_uz: No sooner dan keyin than keladi va had egadan oldin turadi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Never ___ such a delicious soup.
Hardly ___ the house when the phone rang.
No sooner had the bell rung ___ the pupils rushed out.
Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his books.
Seldom ___ such talented young musicians.

title: inversion: so / such, here / there, and others
title_uz: Inversiya: so / such, here / there va boshqalar
rule_uz: So + sifat yoki such + ot gap boshiga chiqsa, inversiya bo'lishi mumkin: So tired was he that he fell asleep. Here va there bilan boshlangan gaplarda ot egasi bo'lsa, ega fe'ldan keyin keladi: Here comes the bus. Ega olmosh bo'lsa, tartib o'zgarmaydi: Here it comes. Ayrim joy-harakat ravishlari (Out came the sun) va only bilan boshlangan iboralar (Only then did I realise) ham shunday tuziladi. Bu uslub ko'proq yozma nutqda uchraydi.
forms: Only then / Only after ... + auxiliary + subject + verb

examples.en: So loud was the music that nobody could talk.
examples.uz: Musiqa shu qadar baland ediki, hech kim gaplasha olmadi.

examples.en: There goes our bus, and we missed it again!
examples.uz: Mana, avtobusimiz ketdi, yana o'tkazib yubordik!

examples.en: Only after the lesson did I understand the problem.
examples.uz: Faqat darsdan keyingina muammoni tushundim.

mistakes.wrong: Here comes it!
mistakes.right: Here it comes!
mistakes.note_uz: Ega olmosh bo'lsa, inversiya qilinmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: Only then I realised my mistake.
mistakes.right: Only then did I realise my mistake.
mistakes.note_uz: Only bilan boshlangan iboradan keyin yordamchi fe'l oldin keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: So ___ the film that we watched it twice.
Such ___ the noise that I couldn't sleep.
Here ___ the postman with our parcel.
There ___ the winner of the race!
Only when the lights went out ___ how dark it was.
On the table ___ a small wooden box.

title: emphasis and fronting
rule_uz: Muhim so'z yoki iborani gapning boshiga chiqarib, unga e'tiborni qaratish mumkin: This film I have never liked. Ta'kidlash uchun yordamchi fe'lni ham qo'llaymiz: I do like it. Shuningdek, reflexive olmoshlar (myself), very/own/at all kabi so'zlar ham ta'kidlaydi. Gap boshiga chiqarilgan qism odatda oldin aytilgan narsaga bog'lanadi. Oddiy nutqda kam, ammo hikoya va nutqlarda keng ishlatiladi.
forms: subject + do / does / did + base verb (emphatic)

examples.en: Math I find easy, but physics I really struggle with.
examples.uz: Matematika menga oson, fizikaga esa qiynalaman.

examples.en: I did tell you about the meeting, but you forgot.
examples.uz: Uchrashuv haqida aytgan edim, lekin unutibsiz.

examples.en: She made the cake herself, without any help.
examples.uz: U tortni hech qanday yordamsiz o'zi pishirdi.

mistakes.wrong: I did told him the truth.
mistakes.right: I did tell him the truth.
mistakes.note_uz: Did dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

mistakes.wrong: He built the house him.
mistakes.right: He built the house himself.
mistakes.note_uz: Ta'kidlash uchun reflexive olmosh himself ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ remember locking the door, honestly!
She wrote the whole essay ___.
That was the ___ thing I wanted to say to you.
Chess I play every Sunday, but ___ I have never tried.
Tom didn't ask for help; he fixed the bike ___.

title: ellipsis and substitution
rule_uz: Takrorni oldini olish uchun gapning bir qismini tushirib qoldiramiz (ellipsis) yoki qisqa so'z bilan almashtiramiz (substitution). Yordamchi fe'ldan keyin asosiy fe'lni tushirish mumkin: She can swim and I can too. So va not o'rnini to'liq gapga bosadi: I think so, I hope not. One/ones ot o'rnida, do so/do it fe'l ibora o'rnida keladi. To dan keyin fe'l tushirilishi mumkin: I'd love to.
forms: I think / hope / expect + so / not
I'd love to. / I didn't want to.

examples.en: Do you think it will snow? I hope not.
examples.uz: Qor yog'adi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilamanki, yo'q.

examples.en: I don't like the red jacket, but I'll take the blue one.
examples.uz: Qizil kurtka yoqmadi, lekin ko'kini olaman.

examples.en: Maria wanted to come, but she wasn't able to.
examples.uz: Mariya kelmoqchi edi, lekin kela olmadi.

mistakes.wrong: Will it rain? I hope no.
mistakes.right: Will it rain? I hope not.
mistakes.note_uz: Hope dan keyin 'no' emas, 'not' yoki 'so' ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I like these shoes, but I prefer the ones black.
mistakes.right: I like these shoes, but I prefer the black ones.
mistakes.note_uz: One/ones dan oldin sifat keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Is Karim coming to the party? I think ___.
Sophie loves skiing and her brother ___.
I don't like this phone. Can I see a cheaper ___?
Did you finish the project? No, but I'm going ___.
Are you angry with me? I really hope ___.

title: articles and determiners (advanced)
rule_uz: A/an birinchi marta aytilgan yoki sanaladigan narsa uchun, the esa ikkala tomonga ham ma'lum narsa uchun ishlatiladi. Umumiy gaplarda ko'plik ot yoki sanalmaydigan ot oldida artikl qo'yilmaydi: Music relaxes me. The + sifat butun guruhni bildiradi: the elderly. Ma'nosi o'zgaradigan holatlar bor: go to school (o'qish uchun) va go to the school (binoga). Each, every, either, neither, both kabi aniqlovchilar sanaladigan otlar bilan boshqacha moslashadi.
forms: a / an + singular countable noun (first mention)

examples.en: She plays the violin, and her brother plays the drums.
examples.uz: U skripka chaladi, ukasi esa nog'ora chaladi.

examples.en: Both of my parents work in hospital.
examples.uz: Ikkala ota-onam ham kasalxonada ishlaydi.

examples.en: Honesty is the best policy.
examples.uz: Halollik eng yaxshi yo'ldir.

mistakes.wrong: The life is full of surprises.
mistakes.right: Life is full of surprises.
mistakes.note_uz: Umumiy ma'noda the ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: Every students has a locker.
mistakes.right: Every student has a locker.
mistakes.note_uz: Every dan keyin birlik ot keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I'd like ___ glass of water, please.
___ honesty is important in a friendship.
We saw ___ interesting film last night.
She plays ___ piano beautifully.
___ of the two answers is correct, so I'll choose again.
The government must help ___ poor.

title: quantifiers (advanced): a great deal of, a handful of
rule_uz: Miqdorni aniqroq ifodalash uchun maxsus iboralar bor. Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a great deal of, a good deal of, plenty of ishlatiladi. Sanaladigan otlar bilan a great number of, a handful of, a couple of kelishi mumkin. Few va little 'deyarli yo'q' degan salbiy ma'noni, a few va a little esa 'bir oz bor' degan ijobiy ma'noni beradi. Rasmiy uslubda a large amount of, numerous, several ham keng ishlatiladi.
forms: a great deal of / a large amount of + uncountable
a great number of / a handful of + plural
few / a few + plural, little / a little + uncountable
plenty of / a lot of + both

examples.en: He spent a great deal of time on his project.
examples.uz: U loyihasiga ko'p vaqt sarfladi.

examples.en: Only a handful of students passed the hard test.
examples.uz: Qiyin testdan faqat bir hovuch o'quvchi o'tdi.

examples.en: There is little hope of finding the lost dog.
examples.uz: Yo'qolgan itni topishga umid kam.

mistakes.wrong: She has a great number of homework.
mistakes.right: She has a great deal of homework.
mistakes.note_uz: Homework sanalmaydi, shuning uchun a great deal of.

mistakes.wrong: I have few time, so I must hurry.
mistakes.right: I have little time, so I must hurry.
mistakes.note_uz: Sanalmaydigan ot bilan little ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: There is ___ milk left, so we can make pancakes.
A great ___ of people attended the concert.
He gave me ___ useful advice before the interview.
___ of our friends live in the same street, so we meet often.

title: comparison (advanced): by far, nowhere near, the ... the ...
rule_uz: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi katta farqni by far, far, much, nowhere near kabi so'zlar bilan ko'rsatamiz. By far eng yuqori darajadagi sifat bilan keladi: by far the best. Not nearly va nowhere near as + sifat + as 'qaramasdan yetmaydi' ma'nosini beradi. The + qiyosiy daraja ..., the + qiyosiy daraja ... qolipi bir narsa o'zgarishi bilan boshqasi ham o'zgarishini bildiradi: The more you practise, the better you play.

examples.en: This is by far the most difficult exam I've taken.
examples.uz: Bu men topshirgan eng qiyin imtihon, shubhasiz.

examples.en: The hotel was nowhere near as clean as the photos suggested.
examples.uz: Mehmonxona suratlardagidek toza emas edi.

examples.en: The earlier we leave, the sooner we'll arrive.
examples.uz: Qanchalik erta chiqsak, shunchalik tez yetib boramiz.

mistakes.wrong: The more you read, more you learn.
mistakes.right: The more you read, the more you learn.
mistakes.note_uz: Ikkala qismda ham the kerak.

mistakes.wrong: He is more taller than his brother.
mistakes.right: He is much taller than his brother.
mistakes.note_uz: Qisqa sifatda more ishlatilmaydi; much/far ishlatamiz.

My laptop is nowhere ___ as fast as yours.
The harder you work, ___ you will be.
This phone is ___ cheaper than that one.

title: adjectives: gradable / ungradable, order, adjectives as nouns
rule_uz: Darajalanadigan sifatlar (cold, tired) very, quite, rather bilan kuchayadi. Chegarasi bor sifatlar (freezing, exhausted, perfect) esa absolutely, completely bilan ishlatiladi, very bilan emas. Bir nechta sifat ketma-ket kelsa, tartib bo'ladi: fikr, o'lcham, yosh, shakl, rang, kelib chiqish, material, ot. Ba'zi sifatlar the bilan ot kabi ishlatiladi: the rich, the young. Bunday so'zlar ko'plik ma'nosida fe'l oladi.
forms: opinion - size - age - shape - colour - origin - material + noun
the + adjective = group of people (the old)

examples.en: The soup was absolutely delicious, but a little too salty.
examples.uz: Sho'rva juda mazali edi, faqat biroz sho'r.

examples.en: She wore a beautiful long red silk dress.
examples.uz: U chiroyli, uzun, qizil ipak ko'ylak kiygan edi.

examples.en: The young are often better at using technology than the old.
examples.uz: Yoshlar texnologiyadan foydalanishda ko'pincha keksalardan ustun.

mistakes.wrong: The room was very freezing.
mistakes.right: The room was absolutely freezing.
mistakes.note_uz: Freezing chegarali sifat, very bilan kelmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: He bought a leather brown old bag.
mistakes.right: He bought an old brown leather bag.
mistakes.note_uz: Sifatlar tartibi: yosh, rang, material.

title: comment and viewpoint adverbs (frankly, apparently)
rule_uz: Ba'zi ravishlar butun gapga munosabat bildiradi. Frankly, honestly aytuvchining qanday gapirayotganini ko'rsatadi. Apparently, obviously, clearly ma'lumot qanchalik aniqligini bildiradi. Fortunately, unfortunately, surprisingly esa his-tuyg'uni ifodalaydi. Ular odatda gap boshida va vergul bilan ajratilgan holda keladi. Bu ravishlar gapning ma'nosini o'zgartirmaydi, aytuvchining fikrini qo'shadi.

examples.en: Frankly, I think the second plan is better.
examples.uz: Ochig'i, ikkinchi reja yaxshiroq deb o'ylayman.

examples.en: Apparently, the match has been postponed because of rain.
examples.uz: Aytishlaricha, o'yin yomg'ir tufayli kechiktirilibdi.

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.uz: Baxtga qarshi, voqeada hech kim jarohat olmadi.

mistakes.wrong: Apparently that the bus is late.
mistakes.right: Apparently, the bus is late.
mistakes.note_uz: Bu ravishdan keyin that kerak emas, vergul qo'yiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Surprisingly he won, but I was glad.
mistakes.right: Surprisingly, he won, and I was glad.
mistakes.note_uz: Fikr ravishidan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

title: intensifiers and adverbs of degree
rule_uz: Ravishlar sifat, fe'l yoki boshqa ravishning darajasini bildiradi. Very, really, extremely sifatlarni kuchaytiradi, a bit, slightly, fairly esa kuchsizlantiradi. Chegarasi bor sifatlar bilan absolutely, utterly ishlatiladi. Fe'l bilan completely, totally, deeply ko'pincha fe'ldan oldin keladi. Enough sifatdan keyin, too sifatdan oldin turadi: too hot, hot enough.

examples.en: The instructions were extremely clear, so everyone finished quickly.
examples.uz: Ko'rsatmalar juda aniq edi, shuning uchun hamma tez tugatdi.

examples.en: I completely forgot about the appointment.
examples.uz: Uchrashuv haqida butunlay unutibman.

examples.en: The water isn't warm enough for swimming.
examples.uz: Suv suzish uchun yetarlicha iliq emas.

mistakes.wrong: It is enough warm to swim.
mistakes.right: It is warm enough to swim.
mistakes.note_uz: Enough sifatdan keyin keladi.

mistakes.wrong: I am very exhausted.
mistakes.right: I am absolutely exhausted.
mistakes.note_uz: Exhausted chegarali sifat; very bilan kelmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The suitcase was ___ heavy; I could hardly lift it.
The view from the top was ___ breathtaking.

title: linking: contrast and concession
rule_uz: Qarama-qarshi fikrlarni bog'lash uchun although, though, even though, while, whereas ishlatiladi. Bular gapning boshida yoki o'rtasida keladi va ularning ortidan to'liq gap qo'yiladi. Despite va in spite of dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi. However, nevertheless, on the other hand gap boshida vergul bilan ishlatiladi. But gap o'rtasida keladi. Despite bilan of qo'shilmaydi, in spite bilan esa of kerak.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we played outside for an hour.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan bo'lsa ham, biz bir soat tashqarida o'ynadik.

examples.en: Despite feeling tired, Nodira finished the race.
examples.uz: Charchagan bo'lsa ham, Nodira poygani tugatdi.

examples.en: My sister loves cities, whereas I prefer the countryside.
examples.uz: Opam shaharlarni yaxshi ko'radi, men esa qishloqni afzal ko'raman.

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
mistakes.right: Despite the rain, we went out.
mistakes.note_uz: Despite bilan of ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was cold, but we swam.
mistakes.right: Although it was cold, we swam.
mistakes.note_uz: Although va but birga ishlatilmaydi.

title: linking: addition, result, sequence
rule_uz: Fikr qo'shish uchun moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides ishlatiladi. Natijani ko'rsatish uchun therefore, as a result, consequently, so keladi. Ketma-ketlikda first of all, then, afterwards, finally ishlatamiz. Bu so'zlar odatda gap boshida bo'ladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi. In addition to, as well as dan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi. So va and gap o'rtasida bog'lovchi bo'lib turadi.
forms: Therefore / As a result / Consequently, + clause
In addition to / As well as + noun / -ing

examples.en: The app is free. Moreover, it works without internet.
examples.uz: Ilova bepul. Bundan tashqari, internetsiz ishlaydi.

examples.en: It snowed all night. As a result, the roads were closed.
examples.uz: Tun bo'yi qor yog'di. Natijada yo'llar yopildi.

examples.en: First of all, mix the flour and eggs. Then add the milk.
examples.uz: Avval un va tuxumni aralashtiring. Keyin sutni qo'shing.

mistakes.wrong: In addition of English, she speaks Russian.
mistakes.right: In addition to English, she speaks Russian.
mistakes.note_uz: In addition bilan to ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: He was late, therefore, but he missed the start.
mistakes.right: He was late, so he missed the start.
mistakes.note_uz: Therefore va but birga ishlatilmaydi.

The hotel is cheap. ___, it is close to the beach.

title: purpose, result and reason clauses (advanced)
rule_uz: Maqsadni to, in order to, so as to (fe'l bilan) va so that, in order that (gap bilan) ifodalaymiz. So that dan keyin odatda can, could, will, would keladi. Natija so ... that va such ... that qoliplarida beriladi: so tired that, such a long film that. Sabab as, since, because, due to, owing to bilan ko'rsatiladi. Due to va owing to dan keyin ot yoki ot iborasi keladi, to'liq gap emas.
forms: to / in order to / so as to + base verb
so that + subject + can / could / will / would
so + adjective + that; such + (a) noun + that
due to / owing to + noun; since / as + clause

examples.en: She set an alarm so as not to miss the train.
examples.uz: U poyezdga kech qolmaslik uchun budilnik qo'ydi.

examples.en: It was such a hot day that we stayed in the shade.
examples.uz: Kun shu qadar issiq ediki, biz soyada qoldik.

examples.en: The match was cancelled owing to the heavy snow.
examples.uz: O'yin kuchli qor tufayli bekor qilindi.

mistakes.wrong: He left early for that he could avoid traffic.
mistakes.right: He left early so that he could avoid traffic.
mistakes.note_uz: Maqsad gapida so that ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Due to it rained, we stayed home.
mistakes.right: Due to the rain, we stayed home.
mistakes.note_uz: Due to dan keyin ot keladi, gap emas.

It was ___ a boring lecture that half the class fell asleep.

title: hedging and softening language
rule_uz: Hedging fikrni qat'iy emas, ehtiyotkorona aytishga yordam beradi. Buning uchun it seems, it appears, may, might, could, tend to, probably, somewhat, to some extent kabi so'z va iboralar ishlatiladi. Bu uslub ilmiy yozuvda va xushmuomala suhbatda kerak, chunki aniq bo'lmagan fikrni faktdek ko'rsatmaydi. Qat'iy fikr o'rniga I would say, I tend to think ham mos keladi.
forms: tend to + base verb; somewhat / rather + adjective
I would say / I tend to think + clause

examples.en: It seems that the new schedule is somewhat confusing.
examples.uz: Yangi jadval biroz chalkash ko'rinadi.

examples.en: Teenagers tend to sleep later than adults.
examples.uz: O'smirlar kattalarga qaraganda kechroq uxlashga moyil.

examples.en: This could be the reason why the results were different.
examples.uz: Natijalar boshqacha bo'lishining sababi shu bo'lishi mumkin.

mistakes.wrong: This is the reason for the failure.
mistakes.right: This may be the reason for the failure.
mistakes.note_uz: Aniq bilmasangiz, may/might bilan yumshating.

mistakes.wrong: Boys are always worse at reading.
mistakes.right: Boys tend to be worse at reading.
mistakes.note_uz: Umumlashtirishni tend to bilan yumshating.

Children ___ to learn faster when they are interested.

title: formal and academic style
rule_uz: Rasmiy yozuvda qisqartmalar (don't), so'zlashuv so'zlari va phrasal verblar kamroq ishlatiladi. Ularning o'rniga to'liq shakllar va rasmiy fe'llar keladi: get -> obtain, find out -> discover. Passiv zamon ko'p qo'llanadi va I/we o'rniga it is believed that kabi shakllar ishlatiladi. Jumlalar uzunroq, aniq va betaraf bo'ladi. So'zlashuv ibora yoki undov mos emas.
forms: It is believed / known that + clause
passive voice: The data were collected ...
formal verb instead of phrasal verb: obtain, examine

examples.en: It is widely believed that regular exercise improves concentration.
examples.uz: Muntazam mashq diqqatni yaxshilaydi, deb keng tarqalgan.

title: nominalisation
rule_uz: Nominalizatsiya fe'l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish, bu rasmiy va akademik yozuvga xos. Masalan, decide -> decision, improve -> improvement, available -> availability. Ot shakli gapni ixchamroq va rasmiyroq qiladi: The company decided to expand -> The company's decision to expand. Qo'shimchalar: -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance, -ence. Haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatish gapni og'irlashtiradi.
forms: verb -> noun: decide - decision, improve - improvement
The decision to + verb; an increase in + noun

examples.en: The rapid growth of the city has caused housing problems.
examples.uz: Shaharning tez o'sishi uy-joy muammolarini keltirib chiqardi.

examples.en: There has been a noticeable improvement in her writing.

title: phrasal verbs (advanced) 1
rule_uz: Phrasal verb fe'l va predlog yoki ravishdan iborat bo'lib, ko'pincha yangi ma'no beradi. Ayrimlari ajraladi: turn the offer down, ajralmaydigan fe'llar esa ajralmaydi: look after the baby. Olmosh bo'lganda ajraluvchi phrasal verbda olmosh o'rtada turadi: turn it down. Ma'nosini sezish uchun ko'p o'qish va jumlalarda yodlash kerak.
forms: bring up / carry out / put off / call off
separable: turn it down, put it off

examples.en: The match was called off because of the storm.

title: phrasal verbs 2 (three-part)
rule_uz: Uch qismli phrasal verb fe'l, ravish va predlogdan iborat: look forward to, put up with. Ular ajralmaydi, ya'ni to'ldiruvchi oxirida turadi. To bilan tugagan iboralardan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: look forward to meeting you. Ularni alohida iboralar kabi yodlagan ma'qul, chunki so'zma-so'z tarjima yordam bermaydi.
forms: run out of / come up with / get away with
catch up with, look down on, make up for

examples.en: I'm looking forward to seeing my cousins in the summer.
examples.uz: Yozda amakivachchalarimni ko'rishni intizorlik bilan kutyapman.

examples.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
examples.uz: Sutimiz tugab qoldi, shuning uchun do'konga bordim.

examples.uz: U shovqinga boshqa chidolmadi.

mistakes.right: I look forward to meeting you.
mistakes.note_uz: Look forward to dan keyin -ing shakli keladi.

mistakes.right: We ran out of sugar.
mistakes.note_uz: Run out of — of unutilmasin.

title: phrasal verbs 3 (business)
rule_uz: Ish va ofis muhitida ko'p phrasal verblar ishlatiladi: set up (tashkil qilish), take on (yollash, zimmaga olish), look into (tekshirish), carry on (davom etish), draw up (hujjat tuzish), back up (qo'llab-quvvatlash). Ularning ko'pchiligi rasmiyroq muqobillariga ega: draw up = prepare. Ajraladigan bo'lsa, olmosh o'rtada turadi: set it up, take them on.
forms: set up / take on / draw up / back up
look into / go over / sort out / follow up
separable: set it up, take them on

examples.en: They plan to set up a small business next year.
examples.uz: Ular kelasi yil kichik biznes ochmoqchi.

examples.en: The manager will look into the complaint tomorrow.

mistakes.note_uz: Olmosh phrasal verbning o'rtasida turadi.

title: phrasal verbs 4 (emotions and behaviour)
rule_uz: Phrasal verblar his-tuyg'u va xatti-harakatni ham ifodalaydi. Cheer up — kayfiyatni ko'tarish, calm down — tinchlanish, let down — ko'ngilni qoldirish, look up to — hurmat qilish, fall out with — janjallashish, open up — dilini ochish, get on with — yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish. Ayrimlari ajraladi: let me down, cheer him up. Olmosh bo'lsa, o'rtada turadi.
forms: cheer up / calm down / open up
let down / look up to / fall out with
separable: cheer him up, let them down

mistakes.note_uz: Fall out bilan with ishlatiladi.

title: idioms 1: time and money
rule_uz: Idiomalar so'zma-so'z tarjima qilinmaydi, ularning ma'nosi butun iboradan chiqadi. Vaqt haqida: in the nick of time (oxirgi daqiqada), once in a blue moon (juda kam), at the eleventh hour (so'nggi paytda). Pul haqida: cost an arm and a leg (juda qimmat), break the bank (hamyonni bo'shatish), tighten one's belt (tejab yashash). Ularni to'liq shaklda ishlatish kerak, so'zlarini o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.
forms: in the nick of time / at the eleventh hour
once in a blue moon / time flies
cost an arm and a leg / break the bank
tighten your belt / save for a rainy day

examples.en: We caught the train in the nick of time.
examples.uz: Poyezdga oxirgi daqiqada ulgurdik.

examples.uz: Bu yangi telefon juda qimmat turdi.

examples.en: It is wise to save for a rainy day.
examples.uz: Qora kunga jamg'arib qo'yish aqlli ish.

mistakes.wrong: It cost me a hand and a leg.
mistakes.right: It cost me an arm and a leg.
mistakes.note_uz: Idiomadagi so'zlarni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: We meet once in a green moon.
mistakes.right: We meet once in a blue moon.
mistakes.note_uz: To'g'ri ibora: once in a blue moon.

title: idioms 2: feelings
rule_uz: Idioma - so'zma-so'z tarjima qilib bo'lmaydigan, butun holda ma'no beradigan iboradir. Hissiyotlar haqida gapirganda ko'p idiomalar ishlatiladi: over the moon (juda xursand), down in the dumps (xafa), on edge (asabiy). Idiomani o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi, uni tayyor holda yodlash kerak. Odatda og'zaki nutqda va norasmiy yozuvda ishlatiladi.
forms: be over the moon = very happy
be down in the dumps = sad
be on edge = nervous and tense
feel under the weather = feel slightly ill
be fed up with + noun = be tired of

examples.en: She was over the moon when she won the school science prize.
examples.uz: U maktabning fan mukofotini yutganda juda xursand bo'ldi.

examples.en: I've been a bit down in the dumps since my best friend moved abroad.
examples.uz: Eng yaqin do'stim chet elga ko'chib ketganidan beri biroz ko'nglim cho'kkan.

examples.uz: Imtihon natijalari e'lon qilinishidan oldin hamma asabiy edi.

mistakes.note_uz: Idiomadagi so'zni almashtirib bo'lmaydi: over the moon.

title: idioms 3: success and failure
rule_uz: Muvaffaqiyat va xatolik haqidagi idiomalar ishda va o'qishda tez-tez uchraydi. Masalan, hit the jackpot - katta omadga erishmoq, back to square one - hammasini boshidan boshlamoq. Idiomalar odatda aniq shaklda ishlatiladi, ularning so'zlarini almashtirib bo'lmaydi. Ba'zilarida fe'l zamonga qarab o'zgaradi: hit - hit - hit, fall - fell - fallen.
forms: hit the jackpot = have great luck or success
back to square one = start again from the beginning
fall flat = fail to have the wanted effect
go from strength to strength = keep improving
a piece of cake = very easy

title: strong collocations
rule_uz: Collocation - bir-biri bilan tabiiy ravishda birga keladigan so'zlar. Masalan, inglizlar make a decision deydi, do a decision demaydi. Make odatda yangi narsa yaratishda, do esa faoliyat va vazifalarda ishlatiladi. Sifat va ot ham o'ziga xos juft bo'ladi: heavy rain, strong coffee, deep sleep. Yangi so'zni butun birikma bilan yodlang.
forms: make + a decision / a mistake / progress / an effort
do + homework / research / damage / your best
take + a risk / a chance / responsibility
heavy rain, strong coffee, deep sleep
pay attention, give advice, keep a promise

rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'l, sifat va otlardan keyin faqat ma'lum bir predlog keladi. Masalan, depend on, responsible for, interested in, afraid of. Bu predloglarni qoidasiz yodlash kerak, chunki o'zbek tilidagi tarjimasiga qarab topib bo'lmaydi. Predlogdan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli keladi: She insisted on paying. Fe'lning o'zi bilan emas, butun birikma bilan o'rganing.

title: fixed expressions and binomials (safe and sound)
title_uz: Qotib qolgan iboralar va juft so'zlar
rule_uz: Binomial - ikkita so'zdan iborat, and yoki or bilan bog'langan qotib qolgan juftlik. Masalan, safe and sound, black and white, more or less. So'zlarning tartibini almashtirib bo'lmaydi: sound and safe deb aytilmaydi. Bunday juftliklar so'zlashuvda va yozuvda nutqni tabiiy qiladi. Ularni butun holda yodlang.

title: word formation (advanced): prefixes and suffixes
title_uz: So'z yasalishi: old va keyingi qo'shimchalar
rule_uz: Prefiks so'z boshiga qo'shilib ma'noni o'zgartiradi: un-, dis-, mis-, re-, over-. Suffiks so'z oxiriga qo'shilib so'z turkumini o'zgartiradi: -tion (ot), -ful (sifat), -ly (ravish), -ment (ot). Masalan, agree - agreement - disagree. Qo'shimcha qo'shilganda imlo ba'zan o'zgaradi: happy - happiness. Odatda, bo'sh joyga qaysi so'z turkumi kerakligini avval aniqlang.
forms: un- / dis- / in- / im- / mis- = opposite or wrong

title: word formation: compounds and conversion
title_uz: Qo'shma so'zlar va so'z turkumi o'zgarishi
rule_uz: Compound - ikki so'zdan yasalgan yangi so'z: toothbrush, well-known, stand-up. U bitta so'z, ikki so'z yoki defis bilan yozilishi mumkin. Conversion - so'zning shakli o'zgarmasdan so'z turkumi o'zgarishi: a text - to text, email - to email. Ba'zan urg'u ham o'zgaradi: an increase - to increase. Lug'atda yozilishini tekshirib turing.

title: confusing words (affect/effect, economic/economical)
rule_uz: Ba'zi inglizcha so'zlar o'xshash ko'rinadi, lekin ma'nolari boshqacha. Affect - fe'l (ta'sir qilmoq), effect - ot (ta'sir, natija). Economic - iqtisodga oid, economical - tejamkor. Ba'zi juftliklarda so'z turkumi har xil, ba'zilarida ma'no. Gapda so'z qanday vazifa bajarayotganiga e'tibor bering va shubha bo'lsa, lug'atga qarang.

title: common learner errors (Uzbek speakers)
title_uz: O'zbek tilida so'zlashuvchilar uchun odatiy xatolar
rule_uz: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q, shuning uchun a, an, the ko'pincha tushib qoladi. Inglizchada gapda doim ega bo'lishi kerak: It is raining, There is a book. Fe'l -s shakli, ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar ham xato manbai: information, advice, news ko'plik qo'shimchasini olmaydi. Savol va inkorda yordamchi fe'l (do, does) kerak. Bu xatolarga e'tibor bering va yozganingizni tekshirib turing.

title: negation (advanced): neither, nor, hardly, scarcely
rule_uz: Neither ... nor ikki narsani birga inkor qiladi: Neither Ali nor Vali came. Hardly, scarcely, barely, rarely - ma'nosi inkor, lekin fe'l inkor shaklda bo'lmaydi: I can hardly see. Ikki marta inkor ishlatmang: hardly don't deb aytilmaydi. Neither va nor bilan boshlangan gapda yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin keladi: Neither do I.
forms: I can hardly / barely / scarcely + verb
not only ... but also; no + noun = not any

examples.en: Neither my brother nor my cousin likes spicy food.
examples.uz: Akam ham, amakivachcham ham achchiq ovqatni yoqtirmaydi.

examples.en: I could hardly hear the teacher from the back row.
examples.uz: Orqa qatordan o'qituvchini zo'rg'a eshitardim.

examples.en: "I haven't finished yet." "Neither have I."

mistakes.right: I can hardly open this box.

mistakes.right: Neither of them knows the answer.

title: questions (advanced): embedded and rhetorical
rule_uz: Embedded question - boshqa gap ichiga joylashgan savol. Uning tartibi darak gapdek bo'ladi: Do you know where he lives? (where does he live emas). Yordamchi fe'l do/does/did ishlatilmaydi. Indirect savolda if yoki whether ham ishlatiladi: Could you tell me if the shop is open? Rhetorical question esa javob kutmaydi, fikrni kuchaytirish uchun beriladi: Who cares?
forms: Do you know + where / what / why + subject + verb?
Could you tell me + if / whether + subject + verb?

examples.en: Do you know what time the museum opens?
examples.uz: Muzey soat nechada ochilishini bilasizmi?

examples.en: Could you tell me whether this train stops at Bukhara?
examples.uz: Bu poyezd Buxoroda to'xtashini ayta olasizmi?

examples.en: Who would not want to travel the world?
examples.uz: Dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni kim xohlamaydi?

mistakes.right: Do you know where she works?

mistakes.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
mistakes.right: Can you tell me where the station is?
mistakes.note_uz: Is egadan keyin keladi.

title: tag questions and responses (advanced)
rule_uz: Tag question gap oxirida qisqa savol bo'lib keladi va tasdiq so'raydi. Darak gap bo'lsa, tag inkor bo'ladi, inkor gap bo'lsa, tag darak bo'ladi: You like tea, don't you? Maxsus holatlar: I am - aren't I?, Let's - shall we?, buyruq gapdan keyin - will you?. Ovoz tushsa, bu tasdiq, ko'tarilsa - haqiqiy savol. Javob tasdiq yoki inkor bo'lishi mumkin: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
forms: positive statement + negative tag: He can swim, can't he?
negative statement + positive tag: You haven't met, have you?
I am ... , aren't I? / Let's ... , shall we?
Imperative + will you? / Nobody ... , will they?

examples.en: You've done your homework, haven't you?
examples.uz: Uy vazifangni qilding, shundaymi?

examples.en: Nobody called while I was out, did they?
examples.uz: Men yo'qligimda hech kim qo'ng'iroq qilmadi, shundaymi?

examples.en: Let's take a short break, shall we?
examples.uz: Keling, biroz tanaffus qilaylik, xo'pmi?

mistakes.wrong: I'm late, amn't I?
mistakes.right: I'm late, aren't I?
mistakes.note_uz: I am bilan aren't I ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: Nobody came, didn't they?
mistakes.right: Nobody came, did they?
mistakes.note_uz: Nobody ma'nosi inkor, shuning uchun tag darak bo'ladi.

title: punctuation and sentence structure
rule_uz: Vergul (comma) qo'shimcha gaplarni ajratadi va ro'yxatda ishlatiladi. Ikkita to'liq gapni faqat vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi, buni comma splice xatosi deyiladi. Buning o'rniga nuqta, nuqtali vergul (;) yoki and/but kabi bog'lovchi ishlatiladi. Apostrof egalikni (Ali's book) va qisqartmani (don't) ko'rsatadi. Ko'plik uchun apostrof ishlatilmaydi: books, not book's.
forms: main clause, but / and / so + main clause
When it rains, we stay inside.

examples.en: I wanted to go out, but it was raining heavily.
examples.uz: Tashqariga chiqmoqchi edim, lekin qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.

examples.en: After the lesson ended, the students left the classroom.
examples.uz: Dars tugagach, o'quvchilar sinfdan chiqishdi.

examples.en: The teachers' room is on the second floor.
examples.uz: O'qituvchilar xonasi ikkinchi qavatda.

mistakes.wrong: It was late, we went home.
mistakes.right: It was late, so we went home.
mistakes.note_uz: Ikki gapni faqat vergul bilan bog'lab bo'lmaydi, so kerak.

mistakes.wrong: Both book's are on the table.
mistakes.right: Both books are on the table.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'plikda apostrof qo'yilmaydi.

title: cohesion: reference words (this, that, such)
rule_uz: Reference words - oldingi gapdagi fikrga ishora qiluvchi so'zlar: this, that, these, those, such, it, they. Ular matnni bir-biriga bog'laydi va takrorlashdan saqlaydi. This odatda hozirgina aytilgan yoki keyin keladigan fikrga ishora qiladi. That ko'pincha oldingi gapdagi fikrga javob beradi. Such + ot aytilgan turdagi narsani bildiradi: such a problem. Aniq bo'lishi uchun this/that dan keyin ot qo'ying: this idea.
forms: such + (a / an) + noun = of that kind
the former / the latter; so, one, ones

examples.en: Many students sleep late. This causes problems at school.
examples.uz: Ko'p o'quvchilar kech yotadi. Bu maktabda muammo tug'diradi.

examples.en: I lost my phone. That was a real disaster.
examples.uz: Telefonimni yo'qotdim. Bu haqiqiy falokat edi.

examples.en: Such a mistake could be avoided with a little care.
examples.uz: Bunday xatoning oldini ozgina ehtiyotkorlik bilan olish mumkin edi.

mistakes.wrong: This students were very polite.
mistakes.right: These students were very polite.
mistakes.note_uz: Ko'plik otdan oldin these ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: It was so a good idea.
mistakes.right: It was such a good idea.
mistakes.note_uz: A/an + ot oldidan so emas, such ishlatiladi.

title: noun modification: pre- and post-modifiers
rule_uz: Ot oldidan sifat, ot yoki -ing/-ed shakli kelib uni aniqlaydi: a tall boy, a swimming pool. Ot keyinidan esa predlogli ibora, to'ldiruvchi gap yoki sifatdosh kelishi mumkin: the boy in the red shirt. Ko'pincha oldingi aniqlovchilar tartibda keladi: fikr, o'lcham, yosh, rang, kelib chiqish, material. Aniqlovchi ko'p bo'lsa, uni ikki joyga bo'lib yozish tabiiyroq.
forms: article + adjective + noun: a clever young student
noun + prepositional phrase: the girl with long hair
noun + relative / participle: the man waiting outside

examples.en: She has a beautiful old wooden box on her desk.
examples.uz: Uning stolida chiroyli eski yog'och quti bor.

examples.en: The girl with the red backpack is my cousin.
examples.uz: Qizil ryukzakli qiz mening amakivachcham.

examples.en: The students taking the exam must stay silent.
examples.uz: Imtihon topshirayotgan o'quvchilar jim bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.right: an old wooden table
mistakes.note_uz: Yosh sifati material sifatidan oldin keladi.

mistakes.note_uz: Who dan keyin is kerak, yoki who ni tushirib qoldiring.

title: collective nouns and agreement
rule_uz: Collective noun - guruhni bildiruvchi ot: team, family, class, committee, government. Inglizchada guruh bir butun sifatida qaralsa, fe'l birlikda bo'ladi: The team is ready. Guruh a'zolari alohida harakat qilayotgan bo'lsa, ko'plik ham ishlatiladi: The team are arguing. Amerika ingliz tilida odatda birlik ishlatiladi. Police, people, cattle doim ko'plik fe'l bilan keladi.
forms: The team / family / class + is (as one unit)
The team / family + are (as individuals, esp. British)
a flock of birds, a herd of cows, a pack of cards

examples.en: The class is going on a trip to Khiva next week.
examples.uz: Sinf kelasi hafta Xivaga sayohatga boradi.

examples.en: The police are investigating the missing bike.
examples.uz: Politsiya yo'qolgan velosipedni tekshirmoqda.

examples.en: A flock of birds was circling above the lake.
examples.uz: Ko'l tepasida qushlar galasi aylanib uchardi.
