mistakes.right: The police are looking for the thief.
mistakes.note_uz: Police har doim ko'plik fe'l bilan ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: A group of tourists are waiting outside.
mistakes.right: A group of tourists is waiting outside.
mistakes.note_uz: Asosiy ot group birlikda, shuning uchun is.

title: subject-verb agreement
rule_uz: Fe'l egaga moslashadi, egadan oldingi yoki keyingi so'zga emas. A box of pencils is on the desk, chunki asosiy ot box. Each, every, everyone, nobody bilan birlik fe'l ishlatiladi. Ikki ega and bilan bog'lansa, ko'plik: Tom and Ali are. Or/nor bilan fe'l yaqinroq egaga moslashadi. News, mathematics kabi -s bilan tugaydigan, lekin birlik otlarga ham e'tibor bering.
forms: Each / every / everyone / nobody + singular verb
Neither A nor B + verb agrees with B

title: prepositions of time and place (advanced)
rule_uz: Vaqt uchun: at (aniq vaqt), on (kun va sana), in (oy, yil, fasl). By - muddatdan kechikmay, until - o'sha payt tugagunga qadar. During - davomida, for - qancha davom etgani. Joy uchun: at (nuqta), in (ichida), on (sirtda). Between ikkita, among uchtadan ko'p narsa orasida. Beside - yonida, besides - bundan tashqari.
forms: at 6 pm / on Monday / in July
during the lesson / for two hours
between two things / among many things

title: used to / would / be used to (advanced)
title_uz: Used to, would va be used to
rule_uz: Used to + fe'l o'tmishdagi odat yoki holatni bildiradi, endi u yo'q: I used to live in Tashkent. Would faqat takrorlanadigan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi, holat uchun emas: I would visit my grandma every summer, lekin I would have a bike emas. Be used to + -ing/ot degani biror narsaga ko'nikkan bo'lishni bildiradi. Get used to - ko'nikib qolish jarayoni. Savol va inkorda use to shakli ishlatiladi: Did you use to...?
forms: used to + base verb (past habit or state)
would + base verb (repeated past action only)

examples.uz: Biz har oqshom hovlida futbol o'ynar edik.

title: contrast: whereas, while, unlike
rule_uz: Whereas va while ikki fikr yoki ikki narsani solishtirib, ular o'rtasidagi farqni ko'rsatadi: Ali likes tea, whereas Vali likes coffee. Ular gap boshida ham, o'rtasida ham kelishi mumkin; bunda vergul ishlatiladi. Unlike - predlog, undan keyin ot yoki olmosh keladi: Unlike his brother, he is quiet. In contrast to va on the other hand ham shu ma'noda ishlatiladi.
forms: In contrast to + noun; On the other hand, ...

examples.uz: Opam matematikani yaxshi ko'radi, men esa tarixni afzal ko'raman.

examples.en: Unlike many of my friends, I don't play video games.
examples.uz: Ko'p do'stlarimdan farqli o'laroq, men video o'yin o'ynamayman.

title: expressing opinion, agreement and disagreement
title_uz: Fikr bildirish, rozi bo'lish va rad etish
rule_uz: Fikr bildirish uchun I think, In my opinion, As far as I'm concerned kabi iboralar ishlatiladi. Rozilik: I couldn't agree more, That's exactly what I think. Qisman rozilik: I see your point, but... Qarshi bo'lish: I'm afraid I disagree, I don't quite see it that way. Muloyim bo'lish uchun to'g'ridan-to'g'ri No demaslik, yumshoq iboralar tanlash yaxshi. Agree fe'li bilan do/don't ishlatiladi, be emas.
forms: In my opinion / As far as I'm concerned, + clause
I (completely) agree with + person / that + clause
I couldn't agree more. / That's true, but ...
I'm afraid I disagree. / I see your point, but ...

examples.uz: Fikringizni tushundim, lekin bu amaliy ekanligiga ishonchim komil emas.

examples.en: I couldn't agree more with what you said about recycling.
examples.uz: Qayta ishlash haqida aytganingizga mutlaqo qo'shilaman.

mistakes.note_uz: Agree o'zi fe'l, be kerak emas.

mistakes.wrong: According to me, it is a good idea.
mistakes.right: In my opinion, it is a good idea.
mistakes.note_uz: According to o'zining fikringiz uchun ishlatilmaydi.

title: expressing future in the past
rule_uz: O'tmishdagi biror payt nuqtai nazaridan keyingi voqealar haqida gapirganda future in the past ishlatamiz. Asosiy shakllar: was/were going to, would, was/were about to, was/were + -ing. Was going to - rejalashtirilgan, ammo ko'pincha amalga oshmagan ish: I was going to call you. Would - ro'y bergan voqea haqida hikoya qilganda: He didn't know that he would win. Was about to - hozirgina boshlanmoqchi edi.
forms: was / were going to + base verb
was / were about to + base verb

examples.uz: Senga xabar yozmoqchi edim, lekin batareyam tugab qoldi.

mistakes.note_uz: O'tmishdagi gapda will o'rniga would ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I was going to bought a gift.
mistakes.right: I was going to buy a gift.
mistakes.note_uz: Was going to dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.

title: probability and speculation language
rule_uz: Ehtimollik darajasini ko'rsatish uchun modal fe'llar va boshqa iboralar ishlatiladi. Must - deyarli aniq, can't - deyarli mumkin emas, may/might/could - ehtimol. Boshqa ifodalar: be likely to, be bound to, there's a chance that, probably, perhaps. O'tmish uchun modal + have + V3 shakli kerak: She must have left. Ishonch darajasiga qarab so'z tanlang.
forms: be likely / unlikely / bound to + base verb

examples.uz: Chiroqlar o'chiq, demak ular uxlayotgan bo'lsa kerak.

mistakes.right: He must be at home.
mistakes.note_uz: Modal fe'ldan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

mistakes.wrong: They might arrived already.
mistakes.right: They might have arrived already.
mistakes.note_uz: O'tmish taxmini: might have + V3.

title: describing change (no longer, used to, gradually)
rule_uz: O'zgarishni ifodalash uchun turli iboralar ishlatiladi. No longer / not any more - ilgari bo'lgan narsa endi yo'q. Used to - ilgari shunday bo'lgan. Fe'llar: become, get, grow, turn, change into. Ravishlar: gradually (asta-sekin), suddenly (birdan), dramatically (keskin). Present perfect hozirgacha davom etayotgan o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi: Prices have risen. Hozirgi jarayon uchun get/become + -er ham ishlatiladi: It's getting colder.
forms: no longer + verb / not ... any more
used to + base verb (but not now)

examples.en: The old cinema no longer shows films; it's a shop now.

examples.uz: Kuz kelishi bilan kunlar asta-sekin qisqardi.

mistakes.note_uz: No longer o'zi inkor, ikkinchi inkor kerak emas.

mistakes.wrong: The weather is becoming more warm.
mistakes.right: The weather is getting warmer.
mistakes.note_uz: Qisqa sifatlarda -er ishlatiladi.

title: error correction techniques
rule_uz: Xatoni topish uchun gapni sekin o'qing va har bir qismni tekshiring. Eng ko'p uchraydigan joylar: fe'l zamoni, ega va fe'l moslashuvi, artikl, predlog, ko'plik, so'z tartibi. Avval gapning egasini va fe'lini toping, keyin vaqt belgilariga (yesterday, since, for) qarang. Tuzatganingizdan keyin gapni yana bir marta o'qing. Har bir gapda odatda bitta asosiy xato bo'ladi.

title: final review: mixed grammar mastery
rule_uz: Bu bo'limda butun kurs davomida o'rgangan mavzularingiz aralash holda takrorlanadi. Gapni o'qiganda avval ma'noni va vaqt belgilarini aniqlang. Keyin zamon, modal fe'l, shart, passiv, nisbiy gap va predloglarni tekshiring. Bir necha variantdan mos kelmaydiganlarini chiqarib tashlash ham yordam beradi. Natijani tekshirish uchun gapni to'liq o'qib chiqing.
